dedupe_keys.name: bgs mineral resources maps england wales central scotland

description: This BGS dataset maps the geological distribution of all onshore mineral resources at 1:50 000 scale for England, Wales and the central belt of Scotland. It is based mainly on mapped geology with limited assessment of economics, so "mineral resources" is used in a broad sense and does not denote reserves or areas where extraction will happen. The Wales layers, produced in 2009 to 2010 with the Welsh Aggregates Levy Fund (version 2, DOI 10.5285/83c4e31f-237d-4fa7-a345-7648315f4d22), also show mineral extraction sites, recorded metallic mineral occurrences, former slate quarries and slate waste, and historic building stone quarries. The data let users relate mineral resources to urban areas, designated sites and transport infrastructure. Access: the BGS product page lists it as a premium product at £0.14 per km2, subject to number of users, licence fee and data preparation fee, supplied as GIS polygons (ESRI, MapInfo, others on request), with free sample maps. Caveats: onshore mainland only, Scotland is limited to the central belt, and the economic dimension is not assessed. For simulation it defines where aggregates and industrial minerals could be sourced, useful for construction material supply chains and for safeguarding resources in land-use and infrastructure planning models. Related catalogue records include BGS BritPits and the UK Minerals Yearbook.
